mission.title: external-secrets: AWS Certificate manager provider for exportable certificates
mission.description: AWS Certificate manager provider for exportable certificates. Requested by 20+ users.

steps.title: Check current external-secrets deployment
steps.description:
Verify your external-secrets version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n external-secrets -l app.kubernetes.io/name=external-secrets
helm list -n external-secrets 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working external-secrets installation.

steps.title: Review external-secrets configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant external-secrets configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n external-secrets -l app.kubernetes.io/name=external-secrets
kubectl get configmap -n external-secrets -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=external-secrets
```
Recently, AWS announced that AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) now supports exporting public certificates. It would be great to have a provider that can sync certificates directly from AWS ACM to Kubernetes.

steps.title: Apply the fix for AWS Certificate manager provider for exportable certificates
steps.description:
We do have an AWS Account for e2e Testing which we'll wire up in CI.

Will you be able to manage to set up you Account? LMK If you need help. I guess issuing a cert costs $15, maybe localstack may be an alternative. ACM seems to be available in the free tier:

https://docs.localstack.cloud/aws/services/acm/

Localstack is largely API compatible, but there are slight differences. We can Figuren them out from CI :)

See the source issue for community-verified solutions.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n external-secrets -l app.kubernetes.io/name=external-secrets
kubectl get events -n external-secrets --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "AWS Certificate manager provider for exportable certificates" is functioning correctly.
